summary: ⟨f, f⟩ is a mean of |f|² over a compact quotient; bound |f|² by M² on a dense set of points and pass to the closure.

steps.claim: ⟨f, f⟩ is a mean of |f(g)|² over a compact quotient (`dataInner_eq_quotMean`), so |⟨f,f⟩| ≤ M² follows from |f(g)|² ≤ M² at every point (`norm_quotMean_le`); the set of points where the bound holds is closed and the points coming from (E-rational, finite) vectors are dense (`denseRange_Φ`), so it suffices to check it at those points p.
steps.lean:
M ^ 2 := V.dataInner_eq_quotMean .. ▸ norm_quotMean_le _ (isClosed_property (.piMap fun _ ↦
  denseRange_Φ.prodMap denseRange_id) (by apply isClosed_le <;> fun_prop) fun p ↦ by

steps.claim: At such a point the value of f is, after the translation `apply_vecAtPoint_add`, a value f(finVec x′) at a finite adelic vector x′, which is ≤ M by h.
steps.lean: grw [← h (finCoord fun i ↦ (0, (-p i).1 + (p i).2)), ← V.apply_vecAtPoint_add _ (-p · |>.1)]

steps.claim: The two vectors agree (V standard: its adelic point is 1).
steps.lean:
simp [Space.vecAtPoint, Space.IsStd.point_eq_one, finVec.eq_unfold, Pi.add_def, Prod.add_def, sq,
    Pi.zero_def])
